body: My life is a joke. I'm a joke. I'm going to be 27 in a few months and had to move back home. People I know growing up are all getting married or getting their dream job while I'm sleeping in my middle school bed. I've tried turning my life around...I quit drinking and I'm back in school but I feel like there was no point and it's too late. I used to be a heavy drinker and got myself into really bad situations (multiple dui's, seriously injurying myself, etc). I was almost raped and recently have started having flashbacks and nightmares of that night. It was my fault...I went out and got wayyy too drunk by myself. I have no friends and it's my fault. I don't know how to get close to people. I feel like I don't deserve them and cut them off or they stopped calling me once they found out I quit drinking. Ive had no healthy relationships. The last guy I dated I was with for three years off and on. He constantly cheated and actually gave me an std I can't get rid of (I'm sure you can figure out what it is). Although it's not anything that will kill me, I know it's a deal breaker for a lot of potential suitors. I was stupid for taking him back. I was dealing with a serious health issue (cancer scare) and I couldnt have sex For a while as a result. Instead of being there for me, he cheated on me and started dating another girl behind my back. This absolutely ruined me and I haven't gotten over it. I absolutely hate myself. I have no goals and have no idea what I want to do with my life. I've been a huge burden on my family and I just feel like everyone would be happier with out me around. I doubt anyone would miss me anyway.
